description: A deeply conversational task teaching preschoolers how to count colored animals.

engage.description: Engage the student with colors and counting.
engage.speech_start: Here we can see a red apple. . . . Can you see it? . . . Now, . . a green leaf. . . . Here. . . . Then we can see a blue sky. . . Can you see the blue skye
engage.speech_middle: Let's count. . . . One. . . Two. . . Three. . . Four. . . Five.
engage.speech_end: Let's repeat again. . . . One. . . Two. . . Three. . . Four. . . Five. . . . Say OK if you are done.

explore.description: Explore many and few groups with the student.
explore.speech_start: Here we can see many apples. . . . And now, . . few apples.
explore.speech_middle: Now we can see many leaves. . . . Now, . . few leaves.
explore.speech_end: You can see many apples, . . many leaves, . . few apples, . . few leaves. . . . Say OK if you are done.

explain.description: Teach that colored animals can be counted.
explain.speech_start: One. . . Two. . . Three. . . Three red fish. . . .
explain.speech_end: One. . . Two. . . Three. . . Four. . . Four blue birds. . . . Say OK if you are done.

multiple_choices_speech.op1: Let's check this one. One, two, three. Three blue birds. That is too many.
multiple_choices_speech.op2: Look here. Two green birds. But we need blue birds.
multiple_choices_speech.op3: Look here. Two red birds. But we need blue birds.
multiple_choices_speech.op4: Now look here. One. Two. Two blue birds! This is the answer!

elaborate.correct_option_speech: Great job! Two blue birds! Now your turn!

multiple_choices_speech.op2: Or this one. Is this it?
multiple_choices_speech.op4: Or this one. Is this it?
